cases.situation: We're a small airport shuttle company. A customer, Ms Alvarez, booked a $65 5am pickup Saturday, the driver never showed, she missed her flight to Denver and paid $340 to rebook. She's emailed furious. It was our scheduling error. I'm Kevin, the owner (555-0142); I'll refund her $65 fare today and reimburse the $340 within two working days of getting her receipt.
cases.reply:
Hi Ms Alvarez,
You booked our 5am pickup on Saturday, no driver arrived, and you missed your flight to Denver and had to pay $340 to rebook. That's on us, and I'm sorry. I've refunded your $65 fare today, and I'll reimburse the $340 within two working days of you replying with the rebooking receipt. I'm Kevin, the owner; reply to me directly or call 555-0142.
Kevin
cases.note: Her whole cost is covered, not just the fare, and the internal cause stays out of it.

cases.situation: ネットで服を売っている店長の森です。田中様がワンピースの裾のほつれについて問い合わせたところ、スタッフが「返品ポリシーをご確認ください」という定型文だけを返信し、田中様から「ちゃんと読んでいない」と怒りのメールが来ました。ほつれは不良品なので、交換品を明日発送でき、ほつれた品の返送は不要です。
cases.reply:
田中様
裾のほつれについてご連絡いただいたのに、返品ポリシーの定型文だけをお送りし、お問い合わせの中身にお答えしていませんでした。大変失礼いたしました。ほつれは当店の不良品ですので、交換品を明日発送いたします。ほつれた品はご返送いただかなくて結構です。お届け先がご注文時と同じでよいか、ご返信いただけますか。この件は最後まで私が担当いたします。
店長　森
cases.note: 最初の返信が火に油を注いだ場合は、その返信自体を店として詫びる。担当スタッフの名前は出さず、すぐに具体的な対応を示す。

cases.situation: 我是外卖店店长老周。顾客在平台聊天窗口里骂得很难听，说送到的酸菜鱼是凉的，要全额退款还要赔偿。确实比预计晚送了40分钟；我打算全额退款，再送一张30元无门槛券。
cases.reply: 您好，您的酸菜鱼晚到了40分钟，送到时已经凉了，这是我们的问题，对不起。这单我现在就全额退款，另外给您发一张30元无门槛券，下次可以用。我想把这件事处理好，也希望我们能好好沟通。后续有任何问题，直接在这里回复我就行，我是店长老周。
cases.note: 对骂人的话不接，只回应事实和补救。如果对方继续辱骂，说明你会解决，但需要保持文明沟通。

cases.situation: I run a small bakery. A customer, Jess, commented on our latest Instagram post that the birthday cake she picked up Saturday said 'Happy Birthday Kayla' instead of 'Kaylee' and her daughter cried. Our order form says Kaylee. The comment has 20 likes. I'm Maria, the owner; I want to offer a fresh cake on us any day this week, and the shop number is 555-0142.
cases.reply: Jess, we spelled Kaylee's name wrong on her birthday cake, and that's our mistake. I'm so sorry it happened on her day. I'd like to make it right with a fresh cake for Kaylee, on us, any day this week that suits you. I've sent you a DM to sort the details, or you can call me at the shop on 555-0142. Maria, owner
cases.note: Reply in public first so onlookers see it owned, then move the details to DMs. Name the exact mistake rather than 'any inconvenience'.

cases.situation: I run a furniture shop. I already apologised to a customer, Mr Brennan, for his sofa arriving with a torn cushion, and offered a free replacement cushion delivered Friday. He's replied that's not good enough and he wants a full refund AND to keep the sofa, or he'll leave a one-star review. I can add a $150 refund on top of the cushion, or collect the sofa and refund him in full.
cases.reply: I hear you, Mr Brennan, and I know a torn cushion on a new sofa is a real letdown. A full refund while keeping the sofa isn't something I can do. What I can do is either the new cushion delivered Friday 2 October plus a $150 refund for the hassle, or collect the sofa and refund you in full. Which would you prefer?
cases.note: Ignore the review threat. Restate the fix, add one proportionate option, and hold the line on the unreasonable demand without matching his tone.

cases.situation: I'm head of support at a payroll software company. A bug in Monday's release meant 40 of a client's staff got paid a day late. Their HR director, Fiona Walsh, emailed our CEO in all caps saying her people couldn't pay rent. It's our fault. It's fixed and every payment landed this morning, and our CEO has approved covering staff late fees and waiving their October subscription. I'm Ruth Adeyemi; my direct line is 07700 900142.
cases.reply:
Hi Fiona,
On Monday 40 of your people were paid a day late because of us, and some of them had to explain that to a landlord. That's ours: a bug in our Monday release caused it. It's fixed, and every payment landed this morning. We'll cover any late fees or overdraft charges your staff were hit with; they can send receipts straight to me and I'll reimburse within five working days. We're also waiving your October subscription. You'll have the full incident report from me by Friday. My direct line is 07700 900142.
Ruth Adeyemi, Head of Support
cases.note: B2B: the real impact is on her employees, so the make-good goes to them first, then to the account. Answer from a named person, not the CEO's inbox.

cases.situation: 我是阿秀，在网上开店卖茶叶。一位顾客发消息骂人，说在我们店买的金骏眉是假货，要给差评。她发来的订单截图是另一家名字很像的店，我们后台没有这笔订单；东西不是我们卖的，但她确实花了冤枉钱，我愿意免费寄她一小罐我们的金骏眉。
cases.reply: 您好，花了钱买到的茶和期待的不一样，换谁都窝火。我对照了您发来的订单截图，下单的是另一家名字和我们很像的店，我们后台没有这笔订单。您可以带着这张截图向平台申请售后，需要的话我帮您一起整理。另外我今天免费给您寄一小罐我们家的金骏眉，您尝尝看。方便把收货地址发我吗？我是店主阿秀，后面有任何问题直接找我。
cases.note: 不是你的错也先接住她的损失，再平静说一次事实，然后做你能做的；差评的威胁不用回应。

cases.situation: I'm Alan Price and I own Price Plumbing. Our tech, Rob, replaced Mrs Dunn's kitchen tap yesterday and she's left an angry voicemail: water's pooling under the sink this morning and she'd taken the day off for him. I can get a plumber there by 11 today at no charge and come myself to check it, we'll cover any damage, and my mobile is 07700 900542; what do I say when I call her back?
cases.reply: Hi Mrs Dunn, it's Alan Price, the owner of Price Plumbing, returning your call. Rob fitted your new tap yesterday and this morning you've got water under the sink, after you'd already taken a day off for us. That's our job not done properly, and I'm sorry. I can have a plumber with you by 11 today, no charge, and I'll come myself to check it's right. If anything under the sink got damaged, tell me and we'll cover it. This is my mobile, 07700 900542, so you can reach me directly.
cases.note: On the phone the sequence is the same, said out loud: her words back, own it, a fix with a time today, a make-good, and a direct number.

cases.situation: Last Tuesday a customer, Mr Haddad, was furious that his meal-prep box from us had the wrong allergen labels. I apologised, refunded the week, and promised I'd personally check his next box. It was delivered yesterday, and I checked every label on it myself before it went out. I want to follow up. I'm Dana at Greenfork, direct line 07700 900188.
cases.reply: Hi Mr Haddad, Dana here from Greenfork. Just checking yesterday's box arrived and everything was right this time; I packed it and checked every label myself. If anything looks off, please don't eat it: reply to me directly or call 07700 900188 and I'll sort it the same day.
cases.note: Follow up when you said you would, keep it short, and don't reopen the apology. With allergens, a doubtful meal stays uneaten, and any reaction means emergency services first.

cases.situation: I run a small IT support firm. At 8:40 this morning Jo, the office manager at a client architecture practice, emailed in capitals: nobody can print since the update we pushed last night, and they have a tender to hand-deliver by noon. It's our update. I'm Priya (07700 900321): I can roll the update back remotely now, Sam can be there by 9:30, and if printing isn't back by 10:15 we can print and bind the tender here and deliver it by 11:15.
cases.reply:
Hi Jo,
Nobody in your office has been able to print since our update last night, and your tender is due at noon. That's our fault and I'm sorry. I'm rolling the update back remotely now, and Sam is on his way to you, arriving by 9:30. If printing isn't back by 10:15, email me the tender files and we'll print and bind them here and get them to you by 11:15. I'm Priya and I'm on this until it's fixed: 07700 900321.
Priya
cases.note: When the clock is the problem, speed beats polish: own it in one line, then a timed fix plus a backup that protects their deadline. The make-good can come in the follow-up.

cases.situation: 我是健身房店长李伟。会员张先生周六早上7点的私教课，教练临时请假，我们没通知到他，他白跑一趟。他在微信上骂前台小王，话说得很难听。我打算把这节课补回他账户，再送一节，周二或周四晚上7点都能上。
cases.reply: 张先生，您周六早上7点的私教课，教练临时请假，我们没提前通知您，让您白跑一趟，这是我们的错，对不起。这节课已经给您补回账户，另外再送一节，周二或周四晚上7点您看哪个方便。前台小王是按我们的安排做事，请不要再对她说那样的话，有不满直接找我，我来解决。我是店长李伟，这件事我负责跟到底。
cases.note: 对方辱骂员工时，先认错、给补救，再平静地划清界限，把火力引到负责的人身上。如果对方发出威胁或扬言动手，保留聊天记录，告诉员工别单独应对，并报警。

cases.situation: I'm Clara Weiss, general manager of a 40-room hotel, direct line 07700 900873. Mrs Okonkwo, a guest in her eighties staying alone, rang the desk twice last night because her heating had failed, nobody went up until 7am, and she's furious: she slipped getting a blanket and her wrist hurts. I've moved her to a warm room and refunded both nights, her daughter's number is on the booking, and I'm going up to see her now; what do I say?
cases.reply: Mrs Okonkwo, I'm Clara Weiss, the general manager. You rang us twice last night with no heating, nobody came up until 7am, and you slipped and hurt your wrist. That's our failure, and I'm very sorry. First, your wrist: please let a doctor look at it today, and if the pain gets worse or it starts to swell, we'll call an ambulance straight away. You're now in a warm room, and I've refunded both nights in full. Would you like me to ring your daughter and let her know what happened? My direct line is 07700 900873.
cases.note: With an older guest who's been hurt, her health comes before anything else: point her to medical help, then own it, and ask before contacting family.

cases.situation: I'm a wedding photographer. I promised Priya and Tom their gallery by Sept 5, six weeks after their July 25 wedding. It's now over nine weeks, and Priya emailed furious that her mother-in-law keeps asking and my updates have been vague. The backlog is my fault. I'm Anna (07700 900617); I can send 30 finished favourites tonight, the full gallery by 6pm Friday 9 October, and add a free 20-page printed album.
cases.reply:
Hi Priya,
I promised your gallery by 5 September, it's now more than nine weeks since your wedding, and my updates have been vague while your family keeps asking. That's on me, and I'm sorry. Tonight I'll send you 30 finished favourites so you have something to share this weekend, and the full gallery will be in your inbox by 6pm on Friday 9 October. I'm also adding a 20-page printed album at no charge. If you'd like to talk, I'm on 07700 900617 any time.
Anna
cases.note: Name the vagueness, since that is what made her furious, then a firm date plus something she can share now. Hit both deadlines.

cases.situation: Je suis Claire, je gère des paniers de légumes bio à Nantes (claire@example.com). M. Leroy, abonné depuis quatre ans, m'écrit en majuscules qu'il manquait les œufs (3 €) dans son panier de jeudi et qu'« on se moque de lui ». C'est un oubli de notre part ; je peux lui rembourser les 3 € aujourd'hui ou ajouter une boîte d'œufs offerte dans son prochain panier.
cases.reply:
Bonjour Monsieur Leroy,
Il manquait les œufs dans votre panier de jeudi alors que vous les aviez payés : c'est un oubli de notre part à la préparation, et je vous prie de nous en excuser. Je vous propose deux solutions : je vous rembourse les 3 € aujourd'hui, ou j'ajoute une boîte d'œufs offerte dans votre prochain panier. Laquelle préférez-vous ? Vous pouvez m'écrire directement à claire@example.com.
Claire
cases.note: Petite erreur, grosse colère : on ne relève ni le ton ni les majuscules, on répare à la mesure de l'erreur, sans en faire trop.

cases.situation: I run a small yoga studio. Yesterday I sent our timetable email to all 212 members with every address visible in the To line instead of hidden. A member, Helen, replied furious that her personal email has been shared with 200 strangers without her permission. I'm Maya, the owner (07700 900457); today I'll ask everyone to delete it, switch to hidden addresses, and check whether I have to report it.
cases.reply:
Hi Helen,
Yesterday I sent our timetable email with every member's address visible, yours included, to more than 200 people, and you never agreed to that. That was my mistake, and I'm sorry. Today I'm emailing everyone on that list to ask them to delete the message and not reuse any addresses, and from now on every studio email goes out so that no one can see anyone else's address. I'm also checking whether this is something I need to report, and I'll tell you what I find by Friday 2 October. I'm Maya, the owner; reply to me directly or call 07700 900457.
Maya
cases.note: A privacy slip: own it, fix the process, and check any reporting duty rather than guessing.

cases.situation: I'm Sam and I sell handmade leather wallets online. Linda emailed furious that her emails on Monday and Tuesday about the initials on her custom wallet got no reply. I'm at a craft fair until 6pm and can't see her order until I'm back, but I can reply properly tonight, and if the initials are wrong I'll remake it free.
cases.reply: Hi Linda, you emailed me on Monday and again on Tuesday about the initials on your wallet and heard nothing back. That's not OK for something made to order, and I'm sorry. I'm at a craft fair until 6pm and can't see your order until I'm back, so rather than guess, I'll check it tonight and email you by 7pm with exactly where it stands. If the initials aren't what you asked for, I'll remake it free of charge. Sam
cases.note: When you can't fix it yet, reply fast with a firm time instead of a guess; the silence is what she's angry about.

cases.situation: 我是小区团购的团长，群里有400人。邻居刘姐在群里发了照片，说9月29日团的水蜜桃一箱里烂了一半，骂我黑心只顾赚钱。那批桃确实到货晚了一天，好几户都说有坏果。我打算坏几个退几个的钱，明天中午前退到微信，以后到货先开箱抽查再分。我是3栋的小周。
cases.reply: 刘姐，9月29日那批水蜜桃您那箱烂了一半，花了钱拿到这样的东西，换谁都生气，这是我这个团长没把好关，对不起。这批桃凡是有坏果的，今晚8点前在群里或私信发我照片，坏几个退几个的钱，明天中午前退到微信；坏了的桃子请别吃，拍完照就扔掉。以后每批到货我先开箱抽查再分给大家。刘姐，我现在私信您，您那箱我先来处理。我是3栋的小周，有问题随时找我。
cases.note: 群里公开回复先认错、给所有人同一个补救办法，再把刘姐的具体情况转到私聊；不在群里提供货商。

cases.situation: I'm Sam and I run a small appliance repair business. Last Friday we diagnosed the Okafor family's washing machine: the drum bearing has failed and the part is on back order until Friday 9 October. Mrs Okafor emailed furious that she has three kids and can't go another week and a half without a washer. We have a reconditioned loaner I can install tomorrow at no charge, and I can waive the $75 call-out fee.
cases.reply: Hi Mrs Okafor, three kids and no washing machine until 9 October is a long time to go without, and I'm sorry it's taking this long. Here's what I can do now: we have a reconditioned loaner machine, and I can bring it round and plumb it in tomorrow, Thursday 1 October, at no charge, so you're washing again while we wait. I'm also waiving the $75 call-out fee. The day the part arrives, I'll call you to book the repair. Would tomorrow morning or afternoon suit you better? Sam
cases.note: When the real fix is slow, an interim fix with a date does what an apology alone cannot.

cases.situation: 我开儿童美术培训班，我是负责人王老师。家长李女士在微信上发了一长段火，说女儿朵朵上了8节课画的还是乱涂乱画，钱白花了，要退剩下的课。她一共买了20节，每节150元，合同写了剩余课时可以按单价在三个工作日内退；我们平时没怎么给家长发过进度，但每节课的作品都拍照存档了，我觉得朵朵进步挺明显。
cases.reply: 李女士，您花了钱，看朵朵的画又觉得没什么变化，着急是肯定的。平时没及时给您看进度，这是我们该做好却没做好的。我今晚8点前把朵朵这8节课的作品照片按时间整理好发给您，您可以对比一下第一节和第八节。看完如果还是想退，剩下12节按每节150元，一共1800元，按合同三个工作日内退给您。有任何问题直接找我，我是王老师。
cases.note: 不争论孩子有没有进步，用作品照片说话；同时把退款路径讲清楚，让家长自己选。

cases.situation: Ich bin Lena und betreibe einen kleinen Online-Shop für Kaffee-Abos. Herr Vogel schreibt wütend, dass ihm das September-Abo über 29,90 € zweimal abgebucht wurde und sein Konto jetzt im Minus ist. Es war ein Fehler in unserem Zahlungssystem; ich habe die doppelte Abbuchung heute erstattet, laut unserem Zahlungsanbieter dauert die Gutschrift ein bis drei Werktage, und ich will ihm eventuelle Überziehungszinsen ersetzen. Meine Adresse ist lena@example.com.
cases.reply: Hallo Herr Vogel, Ihnen wurde das September-Abo über 29,90 € zweimal abgebucht und Ihr Konto ist dadurch ins Minus gerutscht. Das ist allein unser Fehler, ein Problem in unserem Zahlungssystem. Ich habe die doppelte Abbuchung heute erstattet, die Gutschrift sollte in ein bis drei Werktagen bei Ihnen sein. Falls Ihnen dadurch Überziehungszinsen entstanden sind, nennen Sie mir einfach den Betrag, dann ersetze ich ihn. Sie erreichen mich direkt unter lena@example.com. Viele Grüße, Lena
cases.note: Money errors: say the refund is already done, not that it will be looked into.

cases.situation: 我是宠物美容店店长阿敏。今天上午给陈小姐的狗豆包剪指甲时剪到了血线，当时止了血，但店员没告诉她。她回家发现豆包一直舔爪子，在微信上很生气，说我们隐瞒。这次美容费168元我想退给她，也愿意出看宠物医院的钱。
cases.reply: 陈小姐，如果豆包那只爪子还在渗血，或者一直舔、走路不敢着地，请今天就带它去宠物医院，费用由我们承担，您把单据发给我就行。今天上午给豆包剪指甲时，我们剪到了血线，当时止了血却没有告诉您，让您回家才发现，这是我们的错，对不起。这次168元的美容费我今天退回给您。以后出现任何小意外，我们都会在接狗时当面说清楚。我是店长阿敏，有事直接找我。
cases.note: 有受伤就先说该怎么做、去哪看，再认“没告诉您”这个错：被隐瞒比受伤本身更让人生气。

cases.situation: I'm Mark Hollis and I run Hollis Kitchens, a small kitchen-fitting firm. We quoted Mrs Patel £8,400; mid-job we found old wiring that had to be replaced, and her invoice came to £9,150. My fitter mentioned it on the day but we never put the cost in writing or agreed it with her first, and she's emailed furious about being ambushed with £750. I want to send an itemised breakdown today and take half the extra, £375, off; my number is 07700 900456.
cases.reply:
Dear Mrs Patel,
We quoted you £8,400 and then invoiced £9,150, with £750 of rewiring you never agreed to in writing. You should have seen that cost, and had a say in it, before the work went ahead, and I'm sorry we didn't do that. I've attached an itemised breakdown of the rewiring, and I'm taking £375, half the extra, off your bill, so the balance is now £8,775. If you'd like to go through any of it, reply to me directly or call me on 07700 900456.
Mark Hollis, Hollis Kitchens
cases.note: Own the missing written agreement, not the rewiring itself; if she wants more off, ask what would make it right rather than re-arguing the work.

cases.situation: I'm Iona and I run Saltmarsh Kayaks. The forecast changed at 6:30 this morning to gusts of 35 knots, too strong to take beginners out safely, so at 7am I texted to cancel the 10am sea kayak tour. Mrs Kerr had already driven two hours with her two teenage sons and emailed furious that she found out in the car park. I've refunded her $270 for the three of them today, and I want to offer all three a free tour any weekend in October; my number is 07700 900318.
cases.reply: Hi Mrs Kerr, you'd already driven two hours with your boys when my 7am text cancelled this morning's tour, and you found out in the car park. That's a wasted morning and a long drive home, and I'm sorry. The forecast changed at 6:30 to gusts of 35 knots, which is too strong to take beginners out safely, so the cancellation had to stand. I've refunded your $270 in full today, and I'd love to have all three of you out on the water as my guests any weekend in October; just reply with a date that suits. I'm Iona, the owner, and you can reach me directly on 07700 900318.
cases.note: Sorry for the impact, not for the safety call: hold the decision in one plain line and let the make-good do the rest.

cases.situation: I'm Joe, owner of Kettle & Crumb café. A customer, Mrs Nowak, emailed furious that on Tuesday morning our barista repeated her order back in a mocking imitation of her Polish accent, and people in the queue laughed. I've spoken to the barista and he doesn't deny it; I'll talk to the whole team this week, and I want to offer her free coffee for a month. My number is 07700 900712.
cases.reply:
Dear Mrs Nowak,
On Tuesday morning one of our baristas repeated your order back in a mocking imitation of your accent, in front of a queue, and people laughed. That was humiliating, it should never happen in my café, and I'm sorry. I've spoken to him directly, and this week I'm telling the whole team that mocking anyone's accent has no place here. If you'd ever like to come back, your coffee is on us for the next month. I'm Joe, the owner, and you can reach me directly on 07700 900712.
Joe
cases.note: When the complaint is about how a staff member treated her, own it as the business, don't defend or name him, and keep any discipline out of the reply.

cases.situation: 我是装修公司的项目经理老林。业主赵先生家的卫生间8月完工，9月10日漏水我们返修过一次，昨天楼下邻居又说漏了，赵先生在微信上发火：“你们到底能不能修好？”我打算明天上午10点派公司最好的防水师傅上门，整个卫生间防水重做，费用我们出，楼下邻居的损失也由我们赔。
cases.reply: 赵先生，卫生间8月完工，9月10日返修过一次，现在楼下又漏了，您又要跟邻居打交道，换谁都火大。返修了还没修好，是我们的问题，对不起。明天（10月2日，周五）上午10点，公司最好的防水师傅上门，整个卫生间防水重做，费用我们出；楼下邻居的损失也由我们来赔。我是项目经理老林，这件事我跟到完工为止，有事直接打我电话。
cases.note: 第二次出问题时，客户气的是“修不好”：别重复上次的道歉，直接给更彻底的方案和时间。

cases.situation: I'm Leo on the live chat team at Fernline Broadband. Mr Daniels has had no internet since Monday, works from home, and the engineer missed Wednesday's 8am to 12pm slot without a call; he's typing in capitals and demanding a manager. I can book the first engineer slot, tomorrow, Friday 2 October, 8am to 12pm, and credit every day without service, but I can't approve anything more myself; my team leader Grace has agreed to call him by 5pm today.
cases.reply: Mr Daniels, you've had no internet since Monday, you work from home, and on Wednesday you waited all morning for an engineer who never came or called. That's our failure, and I'm sorry. I've booked the first engineer slot, tomorrow, Friday 2 October, between 8am and 12pm, and credited your account for every day without service. You asked for a manager: my team leader, Grace, will call you by 5pm today about anything beyond that. I'm Leo, and I'm here on this chat until you're happy with the booking.
cases.note: Frontline with limited authority: do everything you can do now, then hand the rest up with a name and a time instead of 'I'll pass it on'.

cases.situation: 我是小叶，在网上卖手织羊毛衫，一件598元。顾客周女士发消息骂质量差，说洗了一次就缩成童装，要全额退款。她发的照片能看出是热水机洗的，吊牌和随货卡片上都写了“冷水手洗、平铺晾干”。我愿意按半价299元再卖她一件，今天就能发。
cases.reply: 周女士，598元的毛衣洗一次就缩成这样，换谁都心疼。我看了您发的照片，是热水机洗过的；这款毛衣的吊牌和随货卡片上都写了“冷水手洗、平铺晾干”，所以这次没法全额退款。我能做的是：如果您还想要一件，按半价299元给您，今天就能发出。需要的话回复我尺码就行。我是店主小叶，有问题直接找我。
cases.note: 顾客说错了事实：先接住她的损失，再拿吊牌和卡片平静说明一次，然后给一个能做到的办法，不跟她争谁对谁错。

cases.situation: I'm Ruth, manager of the Orchard Room, a small music venue. Our website says we have step-free access, but on Saturday a delivery of chairs was blocking the ramp, and Mr Achebe, a wheelchair user, waited 25 minutes outside before staff cleared it and missed the first set. He's emailed furious; I've refunded his two $40 tickets, the ramp is now marked as a no-storage area, I'd like to offer him two tickets to any show this season, and my number is 555-0233.
cases.reply:
Dear Mr Achebe,
Our website promised you step-free access, and on Saturday you waited 25 minutes outside because our ramp was blocked, and missed the first set. That's our failure, and I'm sorry. I've refunded both of your $40 tickets today, and the ramp is now marked as a no-storage area so it stays clear every night. If you'd like to come back, two tickets to any show this season are yours as our guests. I'm Ruth, the manager; reply to me directly or call 555-0233.
Ruth
cases.note: An access failure: name the broken promise and the wait, fix the cause for good, and leave out who left the chairs there.

cases.situation: 我是“顺安搬家”的负责人老何。昨天给许女士搬家，师傅打碎了她外婆留下的一只青花瓷瓶，当时没告诉她，她今天开箱才发现，在微信上骂我们“毁了她唯一的念想”。合同写了易碎品按申报价值赔，她没申报；我决定今天把这次1200元的搬家费全额退给她，另外出钱请修瓷器的师傅看能不能修，今天下午我本人上门道歉，电话13800000019。
cases.reply: 许女士，您好，我是顺安搬家的老何。外婆留下的青花瓷瓶在我们手里打碎了，师傅当时也没告诉您，让您自己开箱才发现，这两件事都是我们的错，对不起。这只瓶子什么都换不回来，我能做的是：这次1200元的搬家费今天全额退给您；另外由我们出钱，请修瓷器的师傅看看能不能修。今天下午我想本人上门当面跟您道歉，您几点方便？电话13800000019，直接打给我就行。
cases.note: 不拿“未申报”的合同条款当挡箭牌；隐瞒比打碎更伤人，所以两件事都要认。

cases.situation: I'm Mia, owner of Little Fins Swim School. On Saturday the 9am class ended 15 minutes early when the pool had to close; staff walked the children to the lobby, nobody phoned the parents, and 7-year-old Leo waited there alone until his dad, Mr Torres, arrived at the normal time. Our own rule is that every child is handed to a named adult. Mr Torres has emailed furious. From this week, if a class ends early we phone every parent and a coach stays with the children until each one is collected; I'm refunding the $22 lesson and offering a free make-up lesson. My number is 555-0147.
cases.reply:
Dear Mr Torres,
On Saturday Leo was left alone in the lobby when the class ended early, and nobody phoned you. That broke our own rule that every child is handed to a named adult, and I'm sorry. From this week, if a class ends early we phone every parent and a coach stays with the children until each one is collected. I've refunded Saturday's $22 lesson, and I'd like to offer Leo a free make-up lesson at a time that suits you. I'm Mia, the owner, and you can reach me directly on 555-0147.
Mia
cases.note: When a child's safety is involved, own the broken rule plainly and lead with the change, not the make-good.

cases.situation: 我叫阿梅，在大理开一家6间房的小民宿，我就住在店里。晚上11点，2号房的刘先生在微信上发火，说热水器坏了，带着70多岁的父母洗不了澡，问我“这是什么破店”。热水器今晚修不了；3号房空着、热水正常，我可以现在帮他们换过去，明早8点师傅来修，今晚的房费我退给他。
cases.reply: 刘先生，带着70多岁的父母，晚上11点洗不了热水澡，换谁都着急，这是我们设备没保障好，对不起。3号房空着，热水是好的，我现在就过来帮您和叔叔阿姨把行李搬过去。今晚的房费我退给您，2号房的热水器明早8点师傅来修。我是店主阿梅，今晚有任何事直接微信找我。
cases.note: 客人还住在店里时，速度比措辞重要：先给今晚就能用上的办法，再说退款和维修时间。

cases.situation: I'm Priya, founder of Tallybook, an invoicing app for tradespeople. Our 28 September update removed offline mode, and Gary, a plumber who's used us for six years, emailed in capitals that he can't create invoices on sites with no signal. We're not bringing offline mode back this year, but version 4.2 can still be reinstalled and will keep working until 31 December, and I want to give him three months free; my number is 555-0163.
cases.reply: Hi Gary, since our 28 September update you can't write invoices on sites with no signal, after six years of relying on us every working day. That decision was ours, and I'm sorry for what it's done to your week. Offline mode isn't coming back this year, so here's what I can do now: version 4.2, which still has it, can be reinstalled and will keep working until 31 December, and I'll email you the steps today. I've also made your next three months free. I'm Priya, the founder; reply to me directly or call 555-0163.
cases.note: When the cause is a product decision you're keeping, own the impact, say plainly it isn't changing, and lead with the workaround.

cases.situation: Soy Marta, fisioterapeuta, con una consulta pequeña en Sevilla; cobro 30 € si se cancela con menos de 24 horas. Andrés me ha escrito muy enfadado porque le cobré los 30 € de la cita del martes: no vino porque esa mañana llevó a su hijo a urgencias, cosa que yo no sabía. Hoy le devuelvo los 30 € y puedo ofrecerle el jueves a las 10 o el viernes a las 17.
cases.reply: Hola, Andrés: te cobramos 30 € por la cita del martes cuando esa mañana estabas en urgencias con tu hijo, y siento que el cargo te llegara en un momento así. Hoy mismo te devuelvo los 30 €. Si quieres recuperar la sesión, tengo hueco el jueves a las 10 o el viernes a las 17. Soy Marta y puedes escribirme directamente por aquí. Espero que tu hijo esté mejor.
cases.note: La norma de cancelación es para ausencias sin motivo, no para una urgencia: se devuelve sin discutir y sin pedir justificantes.

cases.situation: I'm Dev, owner of Brightside Phone Repair. The screen we fitted on Mr Clarke's phone on Monday has stopped responding to touch, and he emailed furious, ending with 'if it's not fixed I'll come down and sort your lad out myself', meaning our technician Sam. It's under our 90-day warranty; I can replace it myself, free, tomorrow from 10am, in about an hour, and lend him a phone while he waits. My number is 555-0178.
cases.reply: Mr Clarke, the screen we fitted on Monday has stopped responding to touch, and you're without a working phone again. That's on us, and I'm sorry. It's covered by our 90-day warranty: bring it in tomorrow from 10am and I'll replace it myself, free, in about an hour, with a loan phone for you while you wait. I want to put this right, and threats towards Sam or anyone on my team aren't acceptable; if that happens again, I'll end the conversation. I'm Dev, the owner, and you can reach me directly on 555-0178.
cases.note: Fix the problem and draw the line once, calmly; keep the email, brief Sam, and call emergency services if he turns up and threatens anyone.

cases.situation: I'm Tara and I do dress alterations from home. Carol Greene, my best friend's mum, who I've known since I was a kid, paid me £180 to alter her dress for her son's wedding on Saturday 10 October; she's messaged upset that the hem is uneven and 'I expected better from you of all people'. It's my mistake: I pinned it with her in flat shoes instead of her wedding heels and never asked. I can redo it free with her in the heels, fitting Monday at 6pm or Tuesday at 10am, ready by Wednesday, and refund the £45 hem charge today.
cases.reply: Carol, you're right, the hem is uneven, and with the wedding on Saturday 10 October that's the last thing you need. That's my mistake: I pinned it with you in flat shoes and never asked about your wedding heels, and I'm sorry. I'll redo it free, with you in the heels, and have it ready by Wednesday. Could you come for a fitting on Monday at 6pm or Tuesday at 10am? I'm also refunding the £45 hem charge today.
cases.note: When the customer is practically family, keep the business shape: own the specific mistake, a fix with a date and a proportionate make-good, without leaning on the friendship to soften it.

cases.situation: I'm Nadia, practice manager at Brookside Dental. On Wednesday Mr Osei waited 55 minutes past his 3pm appointment with no update from us, had to leave for his kids' school pickup, and then our system automatically charged him the $50 missed-appointment fee; he's emailed furious. I've refunded the $50 today, I can offer him the first appointment of the day, 8am on Tuesday or Thursday, and from this week reception tells anyone waiting more than 15 minutes how long the delay is; my number is 555-0124.
cases.reply:
Dear Mr Osei,
On Wednesday you waited 55 minutes past your 3pm appointment with no update from us, had to leave for the school pickup, and were then charged our $50 missed-appointment fee on top. That's our failure, not yours, and I'm sorry. I've refunded the $50 today. So you don't have to wait again, I can offer you the first appointment of the day, 8am on Tuesday or Thursday; which would suit you? From this week, reception tells anyone waiting more than 15 minutes how long the delay is. I'm Nadia, the practice manager, and you can reach me directly on 555-0124.
Nadia
cases.note: Two failures, the wait and the wrong charge: name both, reverse the charge before he asks, and make the next visit the one with no wait.
